title: Create 'Where DaemonCore sits' stack diagram
story: As a reader, I want a simple stack diagram so I instantly understand DaemonCore’s layer relative to LLMs and orchestration tools.
description: Produce a clean conceptual stack diagram (SVG) showing: Hardware, Host OS, DaemonCore, LLMs, Agents, Orchestration (Speckit/AgentOS), UI (VS Code). No arrows. No internal terms.
